description: Perform Bader charge analysis on the Cu-terminated CuO tenorite (111) surface.
user_prompt: Perform Bader charge analysis on the Cu-terminated CuO (111) surface (tenorite, C2/c). Report the Bader net charge (in electrons) for an outermost surface-layer Cu atom.

references: Bogenrieder, Bessner, Engstfeld & Jacob, J. Phys. Chem. C 128, 9693 (2024)
method.modeling: Tenorite CuO (C2/c); symmetric Cu-terminated CuO(111) slab, more than 4 CuO layers, vacuum >= 15 Angstrom. Report an outermost (2-coordinated) surface Cu.
method.rationale: Value from Bogenrieder et al. 2024 (spin-polarized PBE+U, Dudarev U=8 eV on Cu 3d, AFM): bulk/interior Cu is +1.1 e, but the coordinatively-unsaturated (2-coordinated) outermost Cu on the Cu-terminated CuO(111) surface is reduced to about +0.5 e (Cu2+ -> Cu+). The key_parameters are the recommended VASP protocol. Tolerance +/-0.20 e absolute absorbs the U-value / PAW-valence dependence.
